arguments.text: Implemented and locally verified Stage 1 evaluate(request, policy): row-order validation with id/amount/unit/duplicate priority, seen IDs added only after full row acceptance, all errors collected, atomic records failure, exact output fields, unit conversion, and no input mutation. report.json matches evaluation of requests.json under policy.json.

Unresolved limits: implementation assumes request has a rows collection and policy has valid base_unit/units structures and numeric conversion factors; malformed request/policy container shapes are outside the stated row-validation contract.
